intro.text: Someone a Knight Radiant mentions in one of Dalinar's visions.

items.text: In the Starfalls vision, set in the year 337 of the Eighth Epoch, a female Radiant told Dalinar, who appeared as Heb, that Harkaylain could predict Desolations with some accuracy.
When Dalinar returned to the vision as the female Radiant and claimed her living Shardplate had a problem, her Windrunner companion told her to talk to Harkaylain or to her spren.
